description.value: A 62-storey luxury hotel in downtown Vancouver's West End, formerly operating as the Shangri-La Vancouver before rebranding under Hyatt. The tower is one of Vancouver's tallest buildings, placing guests steps from the Coal Harbour seawall and Stanley Park cycling routes. Touring cyclists arriving downtown will find this a high-end base with immediate access to the city's primary waterfront bike corridor.
